description: Encrypts a PDF (AES-256) so that it asks for a password to open, and optionally forbids printing or copying. The file is uploaded to conv2pdf and the call counts as one conversion.

input_path.description: Path of the file on this computer: absolute, or relative to the working directory of the server.

output_path.description: Where to write the result. Optional: by default next to the input file, under a name that is not taken. An existing file is never overwritten.

password.description: Password needed to open the PDF, 6 to 64 characters.

name: protect_pdf
title: Protect PDF With Password
